Python snippet executed:
from difflib import ndiff
pre = "Every person is competent to be a witness except as otherwise provided in these rules."
cur = "Every person is competent to be a witness unless these rules provide otherwise."
pre_tokens = pre.replace('.', '').split()
cur_tokens = cur.replace('.', '').split()
diffs = list(ndiff(pre_tokens, cur_tokens))
removed = [d[2:] for d in diffs if d.startswith('- ')]
print('Removed tokens:', removed)
